$Comment: The gear lesson: the table takes a weapon, a piece of armor and a tool alike, and each gives
back what it was made of. Three STATION_INPUT steps, one per gear class, all on Order 1 so
they fill in any order: 'Weapon_', 'Armor_' and 'Tool_' on PREFIX catch every family and every
grade of each class (a shield is a Weapon_ in vanilla, and so counts as one here). Each step
carries its own TextKey because the kind's default line names a single item. Every step is
qualified to the tables ('Disenchanting_Table' on PREFIX, so both tiers count), since the
Sawmill also consumes input and must not fill a disenchanting count.
No hand-in: with TurnInId 'giver' the quest still settles at Orrin, so the player comes back
to be paid and hear his next line. Rewards sit in Claim: Enchanting XP and a short personal
Enchanting boost token (the Mmo_Boost_Token kind: Skill, Multiplier, DurationMinutes), since
Enchanting has no token item to hand over. Retune the three Amounts to change how long the
Name: Three_Kinds_Of_Gear
